universityName: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
description: Staff productivity tool; not authorized for student assessment submissions without explicit course permission
howToObtain: Assigned automatically to designated staff groups; departmental application/payment for other staff categories through ITSC application form
costToUser: Centrally funded for eligible groups; yearly subscription fee applies for other staff categories through departmental payment

evidence.evidenceSnippet:
Automatic assignment
—
Microsoft 365 Copilot Premium for eligible Teaching Staff, Non-Teaching Terms A/HA staff with a current appointment, and University Management.

A yearly subscription fee applies.
Subscribe license “M365 Copilot Education | Item# AAU-89322” through this
Application form
. (M365 CUHK account login required).
NOTES:  Eligible staff will receive a free license without making a purchase. To check your eligibility, visit
https://ai-hub.cuhk.edu.hk/access

AI integrated with Microsoft 365 applications and your authorised Microsoft 365 context.
How to get access
Automatic assignment for defined staff groups; application or nomination for Part-Time Teaching Staff; a Faculty, Department or unit arrangement for Non-Teaching Terms B.
Who pays
Who pays depends on your category. Access beyond the amount paid centrally by CUHK must be paid by your Faculty, Department, unit or programme.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Google Gemini Enterprise Education Licence Request Form For UG, RPG and UGC-funded PG Students

Current undergraduate, RPG and UGC-funded postgraduate students may apply individually, provided they do not already have access through a teacher, course or programme. ITSC verifies eligibility through the existing student records interface and approves directly.

evidence.evidenceSnippet:
The
CUHK API Portal for Teaching and Learning
provides AI APIs primarily for programming classes, teaching experiments, learning activities and approved proof-of-concept development.

Teachers, TAs, FYP student groups and other project teams may contact
elearning@cuhk.edu.hk
or Judy Lo (ITSC) to request additional quota or dedicated access for a specific course or project. Please include the use case, expected number of users, required models, anticipated usage and project period.

Controlled programmatic access to approved models and services.
How to get access
By application, separately governed and subject to use-case and security review.
Who pays
Subject to an approved central quota or an eligible programme, course, project, research or unit funding source.

AI-assisted research service that provides links to sources.

Demand collection and negotiation only. No access request is available yet.

Indicative ceilings support demand collection; they are not allocations or a deployment commitment.

Not yet. Perplexity is at the demand-collection and negotiation stage. Units can indicate demand through the consolidated Enterprise AI survey.
